title: Tide and Swell Forecast Engine Setup
originalRequest: Implement a tide and swell forecast page for local surf spots, integrating NOAA and Wavewatch III data.
latestMessage: Implement a tide and swell forecast page for local surf spots, integrating NOAA and Wavewatch III data.

steps.title: Determine swell train classification and filtering thresholds
steps.instruction: Define the minimum wave period and wave height thresholds to filter out background noise from the Wavewatch III spectral wave data, ensuring only surfable swell components (primary, secondary, and tertiary trains) are logged.
steps.acceptance: The forecast engine correctly categorizes and displays distinct swell directions, periods, and heights on the UI when they meet the target thresholds, based on confirmed user preferences.
